---
title: "Age Heaping Simulation"
author: Casey Breen
---

Summary: Simulate two populations from the same Gompertz curve. One has no heaping
(Myers' ≈ 0), the other has birth-year heaping — 1% of individuals have their age
rounded to the nearest 5 (e.g. age 71/72 → 70), giving Myers' ≈ 1. Plot both hazard
curves from age 65–100.

```{r setup}
library(here)
source(here("code", "helpers.R")) 
set.seed(1)
```

## Myers' index

```{r myers}
myers <- function(x) {
  min_x <- min(x); max_x <- max(x)
  all_vals <- min_x:max_x
  counts <- setNames(integer(length(all_vals)), all_vals)
  tab <- table(x)
  counts[names(tab)] <- as.integer(tab)

  blended <- setNames(numeric(10), 0:9)

  for (d in 0:9) {
    vals_d <- all_vals[all_vals %% 10 == d]
    if (length(vals_d) == 0) next
    if (length(vals_d) == 1) {
      blended[d + 1] <- counts[as.character(vals_d)]
      next
    }
    pop_d <- counts[as.character(vals_d)]
    blended[d + 1] <- (sum(pop_d) + sum(pop_d[-1])) / 2
  }

  pct <- blended / sum(blended) * 100
  sum(abs(pct - 10)) / 2
}
```



```{r}
heap_ages <- function(ages, p) {
  ifelse(
    runif(length(ages)) < p,
    round(ages / 5L) * 5L,
    ages
  )
}

## now we try calibrating the heaping 
calibrate_heaping <- function(ages, target, grid = seq(0, 0.1, by = 0.0005)) {
  sims <- purrr::map_dfr(grid, function(p) {
    age_h <- heap_ages(ages, p)
    tibble::tibble(
      p_heap = p,
      myers = myers(age_h)
    )
  })

  sims %>%
    mutate(abs_diff = abs(myers - target)) %>%
    slice_min(abs_diff, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
}
```



## Simulate and apply heaping

```{r simulate}
N  <- 2e6
a0 <- 1.5e-5
b  <- 0.092

ages_true <- gompertztrunc_simu(
  n = N, a0 = a0, b = b,
  formula = death_age ~ sex, coefs = c(sex = 0), dummy = TRUE
) %>%
  mutate(age = as.integer(floor(death_age))) %>%
  pull(age)

cal_04 <- calibrate_heaping(ages_true, target = 0.4)
cal_06 <- calibrate_heaping(ages_true, target = 10)

p_04 <- cal_04$p_heap
p_06 <- cal_06$p_heap

ages_04 <- heap_ages(ages_true, p_04)
ages_06 <- heap_ages(ages_true, p_06)
 
m_04 <- myers(ages_04)
m_06 <- myers(ages_06)

cat(sprintf(
  "Myers' target 0.4: observed %.1f, p_heap = %.4f\n",
  m_04, p_04
))

cat(sprintf(
  "Myers' target 6: observed %.1f, p_heap = %.4f\n",
  m_06, p_06
))
```


## Life-table hazard curves

```{r hazards}
## Life-table hazard curves
compute_hx <- function(ages, age_range = 65:100) {
  counts <- table(factor(ages[ages %in% age_range], levels = age_range))

  tibble(age = age_range, dx = as.integer(counts)) %>%
    mutate(
      lx     = sum(dx) - dplyr::lag(cumsum(dx), default = 0),
      hx     = dx / (lx - dx / 2),
      log_hx = log(hx)
    ) %>%
    filter(lx > 200, age < max(age_range), is.finite(log_hx))
}

hx_04 <- compute_hx(ages_04) %>%
  mutate(group = sprintf("Myers' = %.1f", m_04))

hx_06 <- compute_hx(ages_06) %>%
  mutate(group = sprintf("Myers' = %.1f", m_06))

hx_plot <- bind_rows(hx_04, hx_06)
```


## Plot

```{r plot, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
## Plot

lt_labels <- c(
  sprintf("Myers' = %.1f", m_04),
  sprintf("Myers' = %.1f", m_06)
)

heaping_sim_plot <- hx_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = log_hx, color = group, linetype = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(c("steelblue", "#D55E00"), lt_labels)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = setNames(c("solid", "dashed"), lt_labels)
  ) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(
    x        = "Age",
    y        = "log h(x)",
    color    = NULL,
    linetype = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  xlim(65, 95)

heaping_sim_plot

ggsave(
  plot     = heaping_sim_plot,
  filename = here("figures", "fig_heaping_simulation.png"),
  width    = 6,
  height   = 4,
  bg       = "white"
)
```



```{r}
ages_true_exaggerated <- ages_true +
  ifelse(runif(length(ages_true)) < 0.50,
         sample(c(-10,10), length(ages_true), replace = TRUE),
         0L)

ages_true_understatement <- ages_true -
  ifelse(runif(length(ages_true)) < 0.50,
         sample(1:5, length(ages_true), replace = TRUE),
         0L)
hx_04 <- compute_hx(ages_true) %>%
  mutate(group = "Baseline")

hx_06 <- compute_hx(ages_true_exaggerated) %>%
  mutate(group = "Age overstatement (50% chance, random 1-5 years)")

hx_08 <- compute_hx(ages_reported) %>%
  mutate(group = "Age understatement (50% chance, random 1-5 year)")

lt_labels <- c("Baseline", "Age overstatement (50% chance, random 1-5 years)", "Age understatement (50% chance, random 1-5 year)")

hx_plot <- bind_rows(hx_04, hx_06)

heaping_sim_plot <- hx_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = hx, color = group, linetype = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(c("steelblue", "#D55E00", "darkgreen"), lt_labels)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = setNames(c("solid", "dashed", "dotdash"), lt_labels)
  ) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  labs(
    x        = "Age",
    y        = "log h(x)",
    color    = NULL,
    linetype = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  xlim(65, 95) + 
  scale_y_log10()

heaping_sim_plot

ggsave(
  plot     = heaping_sim_plot,
  filename = here("figures", "heaping_sim_plot_v2.png"),
  width    = 6,
  height   = 4,
  bg       = "white"
)
```

```{r}
a = 1.5e-5
b = 1/10
x = 0:110
hx = a * exp(b*x)
Hx = c(0, cumsum(hx))
lx <- exp(-Hx)
dx <- hx* lx[-length(x)]
Dx <- round(100000*dx)
## compute reverse survival
( lx <- rev(cumsum(rev(Dx))) )
s = x %in% 60:100
plot(x[s], (Dx/lx)[s], log = 'y', type = 'l')
## now do some random errors
X <- rep(x, Dx)
X_plus_error = X + sample(c(-10, 0, 10),
                          size = length(X),
                          prob = c(.25,.5,.25),
                          replace = TRUE)
Dx_plus_error <- table(factor(X_plus_error, levels = x))
lx_plus_error = rev(cumsum(rev(Dx_plus_error)))
qx_plus_error = Dx_plus_error/lx_plus_error
lines(x[s], as.vector(qx_plus_error)[s], col = 'red')
```
